quote: Our result shows that fine-tuning baselines could reach an accuracy of 93.7% and F1-score of 85.6 for intent detection and slot-filling tasks respectively.
Each utterance was annotated by three annotators so that we could check for agreement in the slot annotations.
guideline: The annotation followed the named entity recognition setup on LabelStudio platform. ... We manually analyzed each generated utterance to come up with the most relevant slot entities ... annotators recommended the addition of new slots ... we gave detailed feedback on the issues with the annotation, and annotators discussed with their language coordinator how to resolve issues.
